persons.name: Bhājudhanamṛcayāviyā
persons.evidence: written in the year given above by Ṣrīvajrācārya Bhājudhanamṛcay-āviyā (?) at Kāntipur

notes: Bendall read the vernacular colophon without quoting it in full: 'From the vernacular colophon it appears that the MS. was written in the year given above by Ṣrīvajrācārya Bhājudhanamṛcay-āviyā (?) at Kāntipur (Kathmandu).' The ending -āviyā or -yā biyā may be a Newar verb/case marker rather than part of the personal name.
